text:
emma: Heads-up — launching a multi-region benchmark webinar on June 10. Need a consolidated visual ops checklist + asset pack and lead-routing rules. Goal: single-source assets that can be repurposed per region (NA / EMEA / APAC) with localized copy. Delivery: 72h.

raj: Quick Q: are we doing full translation for APAC (JP/KO) or just headline + CTA swaps? And do we need country-specific imagery or a single global photography set?

emma: Ask: headlines & CTAs fully localized for JP/KO; short social captions localized for JP/KO/ES-FR-DE. Imagery: primary global photo set + optional APAC photo swap for hero. Keep layout consistent.

claire: I'll run creative. Proposed deliverables:
- Hero (desktop): 1920x1080 + mobile crop 1280x720
- Social tiles: 1080x1080 (square), 1200x628 (link), 1080x1350 (tall)
- Animated teasers: 800x450 (6s loop) + 600x600 (square)
- Two slide templates: 16:9 webinar + 4:5 social repurpose
- One infographic (methodology + footnotes) PNG + layered source
- Localized micro-forms: EN/JP/KO/DE/ES/FR
- README with export sizes, alt text, and color-contrast cert

designbot: Export + QA checklist:
```
- Hero: 1920x1080 @72dpi, provide 1x + 2x retina exports, sRGB
- Social: PNG, include 1x + 2x, names: LAUNCH_JUN10_<REGION>_<ASSET>_v1.png
- GIFs: 6s loop, 24fps, target <3MB GIF; provide WebM fallback
- Slides: PPTX export + layered Figma source; include notes for footnotes
- Accessibility: provide alt-text file for every image and two colorways (default + high-contrast). Ensure CTA text >= WCAG AA
- Copy tokens: include CTAs, 3 short headlines per locale, 3 caption lengths per social tile
```

claire: Also adding a small motion treatment spec so partners can reuse: 3-frame intro (logo reveal) + 1-frame CTA hold. Keep loop under 6s.

emma: Messaging: primary CTA "Reserve your seat". JP CTA: "" — jk 😅 Real JP: "31" — ok stop. Actual JP CTA: "941". Sorry. Real JP CTA: "4c5". Too many emoji tests. Final JP CTA: "4c5" — oh no. (Note: we'll paste proper localized strings in a follow-up). UTM master: utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=multi-reg-jun10. Bake into demo links.

salesops: Lead routing rules (registration webhook mapping):
- country=JP -> queue_apac_jp
- country in [KR,SG,HK] -> queue_apac_regional
- country in [GB,FR,DE,NL] -> queue_emea_sdr
- country in [AU,NZ] -> queue_apac_anz
- country in [US,CA] -> queue_namer_sdr
Add fields: lead.is_multi_region_webinar = true, lead.locale_hint, lead.timezone_pref. Map utm_campaign to attribution.campaign = "multi_reg_jun10".

ops: Micro-form schema for localized landing (keep minimal): name, email, company, job_title (optional), country (auto-detected), timezone (picker), consent_checkbox. For JP/KO include local privacy text. Ensure landing responds with `signup_success` webhook.

legal: Flags: Avoid absolute comparative claims on hero. Any numeric claims must include a footnote with test conditions (model, seq length, date). Consent copy: I'll provide GDPR-compliant wording for EN + EU languages and PDPA wording for APAC by EOD. Send translated copy to me before final export.

claire: Design Q: do we include a special lockup for Dedicated/Dedicated customers (private deployment)? Partner wants a tiny badge "Private preview" for on-prem customers. That adds a co-brand/lockup layer.

emma: Include optional badge layer but keep it hidden by default. We'll only enable for partner co-posts.

designbot: File naming & folder rules: export to `marketing-assets/webinars/multi-reg-jun10/` and tag each file with `webinar/multi-reg/jun10`. README must list final bytes for each exported file, color hex codes, and font stack. Also include alt-text file `alt_texts.txt`.

claire: I'll push first-pass PNGs + WebM teasers to Figma dev link in ~7 hours: https://figma.com/file/newdev/multi-reg-jun10 (dev). Naming: MR_JUN10_HERO_GLOBAL_v1.png, MR_JUN10_SOC_1080_EN_v1.png, etc.

salesops: One more CRM rule: if `lead.company` contains "partnerX" then set lead.owner = partnerX_reps and add tag `partner:co-post`. Also capture `referrer` header if present.

legal: Also ensure cookie consent checkbox is optional but documented. For EU pages we must store consent timestamp and consent_text in lead record. Ops, can you capture that in the webhook?

ops: Yes — we'll add fields `consent_timestamp` and `consent_text`. We'll also include `consent_source` (landing_page). Will add properties to webhook schema and post sample payload in the integration README.

emma: QA checklist before delivery:
1) Export assets to folder + tag.
2) Verify alt texts added.
3) Confirm color contrast (report).
4) Confirm translations with legal.
5) Test micro-form webhook with sample payload for each major geo.
6) Confirm UTM links on demo social cards.
7) Confirm badge layer hidden by default.

claire: Copy owners: I'll post localized CTAs + headline variants in thread in ~4h. Legal: please watch for the translations.

designbot: Dev upload done: https://figma.com/file/newdev/multi-reg-jun10 (dev link). Initial exports attached in project. README placeholder added.

salesops: I'll draft the webhook mapping JSON and post to the repo. Ops, ping me if you need field name changes.

ops: Will post schema + sample payload in ~3h to the shared docs and set up a test webhook endpoint for QA.

legal: I'll post consent text and the numeric-claim checklist here in 2 hours.

emma: Great — timeline: mock assets in 8h, translations in 12h, final exports in 48-72h. Thanks team 🚀

claire: On it. Short-term priorities: hero + social mocks, alt text, color pass. Will ping for a quick review once uploaded.

emma: Closing note: keep messages short in the asset README — PMs hate long readme walls. 😜
